1-2-3: Fun fact: Bulbasaur is #001 in the Pokédex, the very first, and in some games it's one of the three starters you get from me at the lab. Venusaur's huge flower opens as it soaks up sunlight, and its scent calms even those in the middle of a battle.

In PSP terms: You're one of the people with whom everything begins. You nurture slowly and patiently, and you're not afraid to add a little sting when needed. And when you bloom, the whole room calms down around you. What a pleasure to be near you.
4-5-6: Fun fact: Charizard is one of the most beloved Pokémon in the world, the star of countless cards, games and episodes. It may look like a dragon, but its second type is actually Flying. And if the flame on its tail goes out, it means it's no longer alive, so it guards it at all costs.
In PSP terms: You're fire that takes flight. When you're burning for something, you take everyone up with you, and your passion is the flame that must never go out. Few reach the heights you reach.
7-8-9: Fun fact: Blastoise has two water cannons on its shell, and they fire with a force that can punch through steel. It's one of the three original starters, and its Special Defense is the highest of the three.

In PSP terms: You're a steady rock people lean on. You have armor that protects you and those close to you, and when needed, you know how to fire with precision and power. Quiet on the outside, powerful on the inside.
10-11-12: Fun fact: Butterfree goes through one of the fastest evolutions in the game: from a little caterpillar to a cocoon, and from there to a butterfly, all at low levels. The scales on its wings scatter powders that put to sleep, paralyze or poison.

In PSP terms: You're the proof that real change is possible. You started small, went through a stage of turning inward, and came out with wings. And what you scatter around you leaves an impression on everyone who passes by.
13-14-15: Fun fact: Beedrill has three stingers, two on its arms and one on its tail, and it attacks with them again and again. In its Mega form it becomes one of the fastest Pokémon in the game.

In PSP terms: You're fast, focused and not shy about using everything you've got. When something matters to you, you come back to it again and again until it happens. And you always have another sting in reserve.
16-17-18: Fun fact: Pidgeot is the first bird most trainers meet in the first generation, and it flies at Mach 2. Over the years it became a symbol of the journey itself: the bird that's with you from day one.
In PSP terms: You're a person of open spaces and the view from above. You're fast, loyal, and always there from the start. You see the big picture while everyone is still looking at the details.
19-20: Fun fact: Raticate is one of the first Pokémon you meet in the tall grass, but don't underestimate it: its front teeth never stop growing, and it has to gnaw constantly. It's also surprisingly fast.
In PSP terms: You're simple, direct and adapt to any place. People sometimes overlook you at first, and then discover how fast, smart and resilient you are. No one survives like you.
21-22: Fun fact: Fearow has a long, thin beak that lets it peck prey underwater, and it can fly for hours without landing. It's considered an especially ancient bird.
In PSP terms: You're sharp, fast and independent. You have an excellent sense for danger, and you know when to keep away and when to dive right in. Whoever tries to catch you is left behind.
23-24: Fun fact: The pattern on Arbok's belly looks like a menacing face, and it uses it to scare rivals. The pattern differs between versions of the game, with at least six variations.

In PSP terms: You know how to make an impression. Sometimes one look is enough for people to understand what's okay with you and what isn't. And those who know you know there's a great deal of depth under that impression.
27-28: Fun fact: Sandslash curls into a ball when attacked, and the spikes on its back are hard enough to protect it from almost anything. In its Alolan form it even becomes Ice and Steel.

In PSP terms: You're practical, steady and hard to hurt. You're good at protecting yourself, but what's really special about you is that you always bring something good down to whoever is waiting below.
29-30-31: Fun fact: Nidoqueen is a rare mix of power and tenderness: when she protects her young, her spikes stop secreting poison. She's also one of the only Pokémon that are Poison and Ground.
In PSP terms: You're a true protector. On the outside you have spikes, and whoever comes near with bad intentions will feel them. But for those you love, you hold the safest place there is.
32-33-34: Fun fact: Nidoking has a horn that can crush a diamond, and a thick tail that can knock down a pillar. It was one of the first Pokémon with almost every kind of attack, which is why competitive trainers love it.

In PSP terms: You're proud of your strength, and rightly so. You come to every challenge with fire, and you have a range of tools people don't expect. When you decide to go for something, it's very hard to stop you.
37-38: Fun fact: Ninetales evolves from Vulpix with a Fire Stone, and legend says it lives a thousand years. It's also said that whoever pulls one of its nine tails may be cursed for a thousand years.

In PSP terms: You're impressive, elegant, and hold a quiet, deep power inside. People sense there's something special about you before you even open your mouth. And whoever respects you gets a lot from you.
41-42-169: Fun fact: Crobat evolves from Golbat only when it has a strong bond with its trainer. Its hind legs turned into an extra pair of wings, and it's one of the fastest Pokémon there are.

In PSP terms: You're the proof that closeness and trust bring out your best. You're fast, nimble, and can navigate even the most crowded situations. And whoever gets to be close to you knows what an amazing version is in you.
43-44-45: Fun fact: Vileplume has the largest flower in the Pokémon world, and it scatters toxic pollen. It evolves from Gloom with a Leaf Stone, and the same Gloom can also become Bellossom.
In PSP terms: You bloom big. You have a presence that's impossible to miss, and a strength that comes from your quiet. And you're not afraid to be a little sharp when needed.
43-44-182: Fun fact: Bellossom evolves from Gloom with a Sun Stone, and instead of a bad smell, she brings a happy dance. It's said their dance is meant to summon the sun.
In PSP terms: You bring light everywhere. You love celebrating with others, and your joy is contagious. When you're in the room, it feels like the sun came out.
46-47: Fun fact: The mushroom on Parasect's back is actually the one controlling it, and it grows bigger as it evolves. In the games its spores are known for putting targets to sleep almost for sure.
In PSP terms: You're one of those people driven by something bigger than themselves, an idea, a passion or a calling. You follow what you believe in all the way, and that's what makes you special.
48-49: Fun fact: The scales on Venomoth's wings scatter powders of different colors, and each color does something different. It's drawn to light at night, like a real moth.
In PSP terms: You leave a mark. What you scatter around you sticks, and you're remembered long after you've left. And you always head toward the light.
50-51: Fun fact: Dugtrio is a trio of Diglett digging together, and no one has ever seen what's under their ground. It's one of the fastest Pokémon in the first generation.

In PSP terms: You're a team inside one person. You have several sides working together in harmony, and you reach depths no one else reaches. And no one knows everything that goes on with you down there.
52-53: Fun fact: Persian has a red gem in its forehead and is known for its proud, independent temper. It was the Pokémon of Giovanni, the head of Team Rocket, sitting next to him in all the menacing scenes.
In PSP terms: You're elegant, independent and know your worth. You have standards and don't compromise on them. And whoever manages to earn your trust gets a loyal, special friend.
54-55: Fun fact: Golduck swims faster than any Olympic athlete, and the gem on its forehead glows when it uses its powers. It evolves from Psyduck, famous for its headaches.

In PSP terms: You're one of those people who get through the biggest storms and come out stronger. What may once have been confusion has become strength and focus in you. You swim easily even in the highest waves.
56-57-979: Fun fact: Annihilape is a relatively new Pokémon that evolves from Primeape after its rage peaks. It's Fighting and Ghost, combining physical strength with something spiritual and almost supernatural.

In PSP terms: You're someone whose feelings run deep and strong, and you've learned to turn them into strength. You're not afraid of the power inside you, and you use it for what truly matters to you.
58-59: Fun fact: Arcanine is called a Legendary Pokémon in the Pokédex, even though it isn't actually a legendary. It's said to run thousands of kilometers in a single day, and it's a symbol of loyalty and courage.

In PSP terms: You're loyal, brave and full of fire. People feel safe when you're by their side, and you're willing to run any distance for those you love. There's something legendary in you, even if it isn't written on you.
60-61-62: Fun fact: Poliwrath combines two worlds: it's an excellent swimmer and a skilled fighter. The spiral on its belly bewitches whoever looks at it, and it flips depending on which way it spins.
In PSP terms: You feel at home in two different worlds. You have discipline, but also flow. And you know when to go with the flow and when to stand your ground with force.
60-61-186: Fun fact: Politoed evolves from Poliwhirl only when traded holding a special item, the King's Rock. Its call summons all the Poliwag in the area to gather, and it's considered a kind of king to them.
In PSP terms: You're someone people are drawn to. Your voice is heard, and people naturally gather around you. And what's special about you is that your biggest change came from a new place.
63-64-65: Fun fact: Alakazam has an IQ estimated at over 5,000, and its brain keeps growing its whole life. It evolves from Kadabra only through trade, so it's a symbol of knowledge that comes from others.
In PSP terms: You're a person of thought. Your mind is your strongest weapon, and it only gets better with the years. People come to you when they need someone who understands the whole picture.
66-67-68: Fun fact: Machamp has four arms and can land a thousand punches in two seconds. It evolves only through trade, and helps people haul heavy loads at work.
In PSP terms: You're practical strength embodied. When something needs doing, you do it, twice over. And beyond the strength, you're always there to help carry what's heavy for others.
69-70-71: Fun fact: Victreebel evolves with a Leaf Stone, and it's a true carnivorous plant: it lures prey with sweet nectar and swallows it whole. It was a famous Team Rocket Pokémon in the anime, always biting James.
In PSP terms: You know how to draw people to you with sweetness and charm. And when something gets into your heart, you don't do half a job, you take it all the way in.
72-73: Fun fact: Tentacruel has 80 tentacles and can extend them as needed. It's very common in the sea, and has one of the highest Special Defenses in the first generation.
In PSP terms: You reach far, and you have lots of hands to help with. You're very hard to manipulate, and you always know how to protect yourself. Those who know you know how far your reach goes.
74-75-76: Fun fact: Golem evolves from Graveler only through trade, and it can roll down mountains like a huge boulder. Every year it sheds its shell, and the old shell becomes soil that grows things.
In PSP terms: You're a rock, but not rigid. You change and renew yourself all the time, and what you leave behind grows good things for others. It's very hard to move you, but very easy to trust you.
77-78: Fun fact: Rapidash can reach 240 km/h, and its blazing mane doesn't burn those it trusts. In its Galarian form it's actually Psychic and Fairy.
In PSP terms: You're fast, enthusiastic and full of life. Your fire doesn't burn those close to you, it only warms them. And you always gallop forward, to the next thing.
79-80: Fun fact: Slowbro evolves from Slowpoke when a Shellder bites its tail. If the Shellder lets go, it goes back to being a Slowpoke. Slowpoke itself is so slow that it takes five seconds to feel pain.

In PSP terms: You're calm, peaceful and unfazed by anything. But there's something, or someone, that makes you stand tall and reveal all your strength. That's the beauty of it: you evolve through your bonds.
79-199: Fun fact: Slowking evolves from Slowpoke when a Shellder bites its head, and ever since it's been remarkably wise. It's said it can solve any problem, only no one understands its explanation.
In PSP terms: You're wise in a quiet, surprising way. People sometimes don't understand your path, but they see the results. And you always know much more than it seems.
81-82-462: Fun fact: Magnezone evolves from Magneton only in places with a special magnetic field. It broadcasts strange radio waves into space, and has one of the strongest special attacks of its type.

In PSP terms: You're someone the right environment brings a whole new version out of. You're sharp, magnetic and broadcast on your own frequency. People don't always understand your signals, but they feel them.
84-85: Fun fact: Dodrio has three heads, each representing a different emotion: joy, sorrow and anger. It can't fly, but it runs at amazing speed.
In PSP terms: You hold many emotions at once, and that's what makes you so rich and interesting. Even when you don't take off, you get everywhere fast. And you're never boring.
86-87: Fun fact: Dewgong spends most of its time in freezing water, and its white body matches the snow perfectly. It's especially loved for its soft, sweet look.
In PSP terms: You're calm and serene even in the harshest conditions. There's a softness in you that makes people feel good, and a strength that lets you swim even in the coldest water.
88-89: Fun fact: Muk was formed from sludge and pollution, and in some places people love it because it eats waste. In its Alolan form it's colorful and stunning, and becomes Dark type too.
In PSP terms: You're someone who isn't afraid of mess. You take what others threw away and turn it into strength. People don't always understand, but you're actually cleaning up the world.
90-91: Fun fact: Cloyster's Defense is among the highest in the game, and its shell is nearly unbreakable. It evolves from Shellder with a Water Stone, and almost no one has seen the pearl inside.
In PSP terms: You know how to protect what matters to you. When you close up, no one can move you. And what's inside, for those lucky enough to see it, is a true pearl.
92-93-94: Fun fact: Gengar is one of the most beloved Ghost Pokémon, and it's said that when someone feels a sudden chill, Gengar is probably hiding in their shadow. It evolves from Haunter only through trade.
In PSP terms: You're mischievous, mysterious and clever. You know how to play with situations, and you always have a surprise up your sleeve. And people remember you long after you're gone.
95-208: Fun fact: Steelix evolves from Onix only through trade holding a Metal Coat, turning from stone to steel. It lives deep underground, and is one of the largest Pokémon.
In PSP terms: You're someone whose big change came from a new place and made them unbreakable. You're huge in presence, and very hard to hurt.
96-97: Fun fact: Hypno holds a pendulum it uses to hypnotize and put to sleep. It feeds on dreams, and it's said to like children's dreams most of all.
In PSP terms: You know how to calm people and lead them. You can understand what others are going through, and sometimes you know what they're dreaming before they do.
98-99: Fun fact: Kingler has one huge claw that can exert 10,000 horsepower of pressure. It's so heavy it struggles to move it.
In PSP terms: You're someone with one huge strength that decides every struggle. It may not always be easy to carry, but when it goes into action, no one can stand against it.
100-101: Fun fact: Electrode is one of the fastest Pokémon in the classic games, and it looks exactly like a Poké Ball, so many trainers got confused and touched it by mistake. It tends to explode when annoyed.
In PSP terms: You're fast, full of energy and unpredictable. People think they know what you are, and then you surprise them. And you have enough power in you to light up a whole city.
102-103: Fun fact: Exeggutor evolves from Exeggcute with a Leaf Stone, and has three heads that each think separately. In its Alolan form it towers ten meters tall and becomes Dragon type too.
In PSP terms: You're someone with several heads thinking together, and that's what makes you so creative. When all your parts line up, you produce ideas no one else would think of.
104-105: Fun fact: Marowak wears a skull and holds a bone it uses as a boomerang. One of the most moving stories in gaming history is the mother Marowak in the Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town.
In PSP terms: You're someone who carries those they lost and turned it into strength. There's a depth and loyalty in you few understand, and you protect what matters to you with all your might.
108-463: Fun fact: Lickilicky evolves from Lickitung only after learning the move Rollout. Its tongue can stretch to ten times its height, and it uses it like a hand.
In PSP terms: You're someone whose words reach far. You're curious, taste everything and touch everything, and that's what makes your world so rich.
109-110: Fun fact: Weezing is two gas balls joined together, and it was the famous Pokémon of James from Team Rocket. In Galar it has a form that cleans the air and even wears a top hat of smoke.
In PSP terms: You're someone who knows how to work as a team, with more to you than meets the eye. You know how to fill a room with atmosphere, and sometimes that's exactly what's needed.
111-112-464: Fun fact: Rhyperior evolves from Rhydon only through trade holding a protective item, and it can fire rocks from its palms like a cannon. Rhydon was one of the first Pokémon ever designed.
In PSP terms: You're a force that can't be stopped. You're resilient, strong and persistent, and no blow moves you. And when you decide to go forward, the road simply opens up.
114-465: Fun fact: Tangrowth evolves from Tangela only after learning the move Ancient Power. Its vines grow back right after they're torn, and no one has seen what's hidden beneath them.
In PSP terms: You're mysterious and full of layers. Even when something hurts you, you grow back fast. And people will always look for what's hidden under all your ties.
115: Fun fact: Kangaskhan is a mother who always carries her little one in her pouch, and never lets it be separated from her. There's a legend about a human child raised by a Kangaskhan.
In PSP terms: You're everyone's protector. People feel at home with you, and you always carry those close to you. Complete from the start, and ready for anything.
116-117-230: Fun fact: Kingdra evolves from Seadra only through trade holding a Dragon Scale, and it lives in the depths of the sea. It's said that when it yawns, it creates huge whirlpools.
In PSP terms: You're someone with depth and majesty. You're balanced in everything, and your strength comes from the depths. And a big change in you came from a new place.
118-119: Fun fact: Seaking swims in strong currents, and uses its horn to dig nests in rocks. In autumn the males compete in dances to attract mates.
In PSP terms: You're someone who builds a home stubbornly and wisely. You swim against the current when needed, and always make sure what's dear to you won't be swept away.
120-121: Fun fact: Starmie evolves from Staryu with a Water Stone, and the red core at its center glows in seven colors. Some trainers thought it came from outer space.
In PSP terms: You're brilliant, mysterious and full of mental power. You have a heart that glows in every color of the rainbow, and people look at you as if you came from another world.
123-212: Fun fact: Scizor evolves from Scyther only through trade holding a Metal Coat, and its pincers are patterned like eyes to scare rivals. It's one of the most beloved competitive Pokémon of all time.
In PSP terms: You're someone whose big change made them unbreakable. You're sharp, precise and tough, and people know they can count on you.
123-900: Fun fact: Kleavor is an ancient form that evolves from Scyther with a Black Augurite, and its axes are made of stone. The people of Hisui used the axes it shed to make tools.

In PSP terms: You're a force of nature. You break through, build from scratch, and don't wait for anyone to clear the obstacles for you. One moment changed everything for you, and since then you've been unstoppable.
127: Fun fact: Pinsir uses the pincers on its head to grab and toss rivals, and in its Mega form it gets wings and becomes Flying type too.
In PSP terms: You're direct, strong and uncompromising. When you grab hold of something, you don't let go. And people know that with you by their side, they're protected.
128: Fun fact: Tauros live in herds and whip themselves with their three tails to get fired up. In Paldea they have three different forms.
In PSP terms: You're full of energy and fire, and you don't let anyone tell you where to go. You charge forward, and people are drawn to your power.
129-130: Fun fact: Gyarados evolves from Magikarp, the Pokémon considered the weakest in the world, and it's one of the most dramatic evolution stories. According to legend, it's precisely weakness and persistence that turned it into a dragon.

In PSP terms: You're the most inspiring story. Maybe people once underestimated you, but slowly and persistently you became a force impossible to ignore. And whoever looked down on you then looks at you with admiration today.
131: Fun fact: Lapras was once on the brink of extinction, and people protected it until its population recovered. It loves carrying people across the sea on its back, and it sings beautiful songs.
In PSP terms: You're someone people want to go on a journey with. You're calm, wise and generous, always ready to carry others on your back. And when you sing, the whole sea listens.
132: Fun fact: Ditto can turn into any Pokémon it meets and copy even its moves. It's also the only Pokémon that can breed with almost any other Pokémon.
In PSP terms: You're someone who adapts to every person and every place, and that's a rare talent. You understand people so well that you can see the world through their eyes.
133-134: Fun fact: Vaporeon evolves from Eevee with a Water Stone, and it can melt into water and disappear completely. Eevee itself is the Pokémon with the most ways to evolve: eight.
In PSP terms: You're flowing, calm, and blend into any environment. People feel comfortable with you, and you have a depth that's revealed only to those who dive in. Like water, you can be anything.
133-135: Fun fact: Jolteon evolves from Eevee with a Thunder Stone, and its fur turns into electrified spikes when it's angry. It's one of the fastest Pokémon there are.
In PSP terms: You're fast, sharp and full of spark. You pick things up before everyone else, and react before others even understand what happened. And your energy is contagious.
133-136: Fun fact: Flareon evolves from Eevee with a Fire Stone, and its body temperature can exceed 800 degrees. Its thick fur is there to release the heat.
In PSP terms: You're warm, enthusiastic and lovely to hug. There's an inner fire in you that warms everyone around you. And when you get excited, it's impossible not to get excited with you.
133-196: Fun fact: Espeon evolves from Eevee only with a strong bond with its trainer, during the day. Its fur senses changes in the air, and it can predict the weather and what the opponent is about to do.
In PSP terms: You're sensitive, wise, and pick up what others don't see. Your close bonds are what made you the best version of yourself. And you always know what's about to happen.
133-197: Fun fact: Umbreon evolves from Eevee only with a strong bond with its trainer, at night. The rings on its body glow in the moonlight, and it secretes toxic sweat when angry.
In PSP terms: You're a loyal guardian. You're steady, strong inside, and shine exactly when the dark is deepest. Whoever wins your closeness knows they have a protector for life.
133-470: Fun fact: Leafeon evolves from Eevee when it trains near a moss-covered rock, and it has plant cells: it photosynthesizes. Its tail is as sharp as a sword.
In PSP terms: You're calm, natural and full of life. You draw strength from the right place and the right people. And you have a sharpness that surprises anyone who underestimates your softness.
133-471: Fun fact: Glaceon evolves from Eevee when it trains near an icy rock, and it can lower its body temperature to create diamond dust. Its fur is frozen and sharp.
In PSP terms: You're elegant, quiet, and cool in the best way. You know how to keep your composure, and out of that cool you create beautiful, sparkling things.
133-700: Fun fact: Sylveon evolves from Eevee with a strong bond with its trainer and a Fairy-type move. Its ribbons calm people and help it sense emotions.

In PSP terms: You're the social glue. You feel everyone's emotions, and know how to ease any tension with a single touch. And whoever earns your friendship gets someone who will always wrap them in warmth.
137-233-474: Fun fact: Porygon is the first Pokémon ever created artificially, by scientists. Porygon-Z evolved with a strange disc, and became very powerful, but also a bit unpredictable.
In PSP terms: You're someone who built themselves, step by step. You think differently from everyone else, and sometimes it seems odd, but that's also what makes you so strong and original.
138-139: Fun fact: Omastar is a fossil Pokémon revived in a lab, and scientists think its heavy shell caused its extinction. In the fan community it has devoted followers as "Lord Helix".
In PSP terms: You're someone with a rich past and a hard shell. You protect yourself well, and you have impressive mental power. And people admire you more than you even know.
140-141: Fun fact: Kabutops is a fossil Pokémon that lived in warm times millions of years ago. It swims very fast, and its scythes are sharp enough to cut anything.
In PSP terms: You're sharp, fast and independent. There's something ancient and real in you that doesn't change with fashions. And when you go into action, you do it with perfect precision.
142: Fun fact: Aerodactyl is a fossil Pokémon revived from ancient amber. It's one of the fastest Pokémon, and in its Mega form it becomes even more menacing.
In PSP terms: You're wild, fast and free. There's something ancient and powerful in you that has come to life, and nothing can stop you when you take off.
147-148-149: Fun fact: Dragonite is one of the strongest Pokémon in the world, able to circle the globe in just 16 hours. Despite its size, it's known for being kind-hearted and rescuing sinking ships.
In PSP terms: You're enormous power with a huge heart. You evolved slowly, very slowly, but when you reached your peak, few can match you. And you always use that power to help.
152-153-154: Fun fact: Meganium is a second-generation starter, and the scent of the flower around its neck calms and heals. It's said that whoever is near it feels quiet and peace.
In PSP terms: You're one of those people it's simply good to be around. You can calm any storm and make people feel safe. You're an anchor of calm.
155-156-157: Fun fact: Typhlosion is a second-generation starter, and it hides behind a wall of flames when threatening. It has exactly the same stats as Charizard.
In PSP terms: You're someone whose fire builds quietly, then erupts with force. People sometimes don't realize how much fire you have, until they see you in action.
158-159-160: Fun fact: Feraligatr is a second-generation starter, and its jaws are so strong it never lets go of what it catches. In the anime, Totodile dances happily all the time.
In PSP terms: You're someone with strength and decisiveness, but also a lot of joy for life. You grab what you want and don't let go, and you do it with a smile.
161-162: Fun fact: Furret evolves from Sentret, and it digs tunnels so narrow only it can pass through them. Furret mothers raise their young in a deep nest dug underground.
In PSP terms: You're nimble, cute, and know how to slip out of any situation. You find ways no one else sees, and always know how to get out of any corner.
163-164: Fun fact: Noctowl sees in the dark as if it were day, and can turn its head 180 degrees. It's one of the symbols of wisdom in the Pokémon world.
In PSP terms: You're wise, patient, and see things others miss. You're not quick to judge, and you look at everything from every direction. And people come to you when they need advice.
165-166: Fun fact: Ledian flies at night scattering glittering dust, and it's said that whoever touches it gets lucky. The spots on its back mark its age.
In PSP terms: You bring luck wherever you go. You scatter sparkles quietly, without seeking attention, and people feel better after meeting you.
167-168: Fun fact: Ariados spins very strong webs, attaching a thread that lets it feel every movement. It goes hunting at night.
In PSP terms: You're someone who builds a strong network of connections and feels every movement in it. You're patient, calculated, and know exactly when to act.
170-171: Fun fact: Lanturn lives in the depths of the sea, and the light it gives off can be seen above the water's surface. It's called "the deep-sea star".
In PSP terms: You shine in the dark. Even when everything around is deepest and darkest, you have a light of your own, and people find their way to you thanks to it.
172-25-26: Fun fact: Raichu evolves from Pikachu with a Thunder Stone, and can release a current of 100,000 volts. Pikachu itself is the most famous mascot in the Pokémon world.
In PSP terms: You're someone with contagious energy that everyone remembers. You chose to grow and evolve, even when it would have been easy to stay cute and familiar. That takes courage.
173-35-36: Fun fact: Clefable evolves from Clefairy with a Moon Stone, and it's said to come from the moon and listen to the voices of its friends there. It's very rare and appears mainly on full-moon nights.
In PSP terms: You're gentle, magical and special. There's something dreamlike in you, of a quiet night and a full moon. And people feel lucky when they meet you.
174-39-40: Fun fact: Wigglytuff evolves from Jigglypuff with a Moon Stone, and its fur is so soft people can't stop petting it. Jigglypuff is famous for its song that puts everyone to sleep.
In PSP terms: You're soft, warm and pleasant, and people simply love being near you. You have a big heart, and you give of yourself without keeping count.
175-176-468: Fun fact: Togekiss evolves from Togetic with a Shiny Stone, and it's said to appear only where there is peace and harmony. Togepi, the first form, is considered a symbol of happiness and good luck.
In PSP terms: You're someone who brings peace and joy with them. People calm down around you, and when you're around, everything seems to fall into place. To me, you're a rare gift.
177-178: Fun fact: Xatu stands all day without moving, gazing at the sun, and it's said to see both the past and the future. In some places it's treated as an oracle.
In PSP terms: You're someone who sees far. You observe, stay silent, and understand things before everyone else. People sometimes think you're just standing there, but you actually see everything.
179-180-181: Fun fact: Ampharos's tail glows so brightly that it was once used as a lighthouse for sailors. In the anime, an Ampharos helped light up a real lighthouse.
In PSP terms: You're a lighthouse. You light the way for others, even on the darkest nights. And people know that if they follow your light, they'll get home.
